it's completely oversized dan bahannya tebal, jadi bener-bener kayak blazer mahal yang bagus banget gitu potongannya I freaking love this, you see this? this is like a whole look lupa rumpa ke tas, so this is it I can go out right now and I feel like a million dollar this is so freaking good tapi gue juga beli celana ini, like I know it's so good, this is also like amazingly comfortable yang ini belakangnya ada karatnya, but it still looks fine but if you wanna talk about comfort, I would say this is more comfortable than the gray one dan kayak jadi ngepas banget gitu kan di pinggangnya, so it looks beautiful sendalannya kita akan pakai yang ini, ini juga salah satu kesukaan gue sekarang pake ini juga lucu gitu keliatannya dan gue temen lagi males banget pakai sepatu, gak tau rumpa gue lagi mau bibet pakai sendal but that's it, it's all that I bought this time and I love every single one of them they're so good
